page.overview:
What is Adventure Endoplush?

is one of the unlockable characters in FNaF World.

Endoplush is a very small endoskeleton, with a pair of green eyes and a pair of small antennae from the top of its head. It also has a green button on its chest.

Endoplush is an interesting character to use. Like Adventure Withered Bonnie, he has Eye Beam, which can do a wide range of damage to an enemy in front of it, usually ranging from 100 to 1200. In order for Eye Beam to be effective, try to play Endoplush in the 3rd spot in the party to ensure it hits a target.

Like Adventure Endo-02, he has Neon Wall, which is important for the final boss or glitched worlds, as it blocks the Alarm attack used by the final bosses and the glitched enemies. Neon Wall also raises the characters defenses, blocking 50% damage for thirty seconds.
